MY WORLD
IS ALIVE

Millie, cats, oceans, Shiva, Wonderland, cargo, claims, music, justice, silence, rage, trust and the strange colors that survived.
Millie is my labbie baby — part cow, part guardian, part clown, part wolf. Most days I protect her. Then she faces the door and reminds me that she has been protecting something in me too.
← सही वक़्त पर, सही भाव में बिकना!
I. The emotional center

The dog who made trust physical again.

I have spent years reading motives, incentives, risks and the ask behind the ask. Millie does not arrive with a hidden proposition. She arrives with warmth, weight, breath, appetite, routine and faith.

She becomes still. She faces the door. Her attention narrows. For a while, I am no longer the only one watching everything.
